'''G0-T9''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had been considered a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-level threat at some point prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When subjected to the [[Wreyn-Tsatke Cyber-Psychology Scale]], a psychological test, G0-T9 received a score of 8-HSM&mdash;signifying a level 8 intelligence.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
G0-T9 was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the companion character [[SCORPIO]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: SCORPIO}}</ref>
